$comment: Reference values for the Claude Connectors Directory portal. Claude does not publish an upload schema for remote connector listings.

listing.name: Terminal49
listing.description: Terminal49 helps users find and monitor ocean shipments and containers, filter and count their container worklists (by status, terminal, carrier, holds, last free day, arrival, or company), inspect routes and transport events, check supported shipping lines, create new tracking requests, and, where trade intelligence is enabled, research US ocean import markets (importers, products, origins, ports, and carriers).

primary_use_cases: Find and monitor ocean shipments and containers
Filter and count container worklists by status, terminal, carrier, holds, last free day, or company
Research US ocean import markets: importers, products, origin countries, ports, and carriers
